svg.text: Kit 75 px, Ricky 79 px (real renders). ATS estimate 91 px at yaw 5, on free grass nearer the camera (left of Ricky).
Grey: body 18 vs grass 1.74:1, so the ink outline, the ink treads and the ink screen carry the read.
In grey the ATS reads as a mid-grey box with a dark base and a dark face band: apart from Kit (mid), Ricky (dark), Ghosties (light).
